title:
*** Meet the board of Trustees***

We wanted to introduce to you our trustees 

From Left to right

Kathy - She has been on the board since Blue Pits began and enjoys following our Facebook page and activities , I am a NHS nurse 

Chrissie - I am friendly, caring person and peoples wellbeing is paramount , my background is in housing 

Sarah - I am a Yorkshire Lass, and a rock chick at heart, I have a motorcycle license and enjoy off roading Landrovers and being a member of a gun club 

Pete - I worked for the NHS for 30 years in finance, and management accounting, I am AAT qualified, I enjoy volunteering for BPHA and am proud of the valuable contribution the charity makes in the community 

#bluepitshousingaction #BoardOfTrustees

#socialcare #charity
